files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Added
- Scan a selected root folder for folders containing images or videos.
- Select individual, multiple, or all discovered folders.
- Create matching Nextcloud Photos albums using the folder name.
- Optionally include media from nested subfolders.
- Skip existing albums or update them with media from the selected folder.
- Keep original files and folder structure unchanged.
